# HTML Parser

> **Note:**
>
> #### HTML Parser
> 
> The HTML Parser is a utility plugin for Pentaho Data Integration (PDI) that extracts desired text from HTML or XML files. Useful for cleaning data for natural language processing tasks like sentiment analysis and SEO keyword analysis.
> 
> * Accepts input from both data streams and files
> * Supports parsing using Xpath expressions or CSS selectors
> * Can process single files or multiple inputs from a stream
> * Compatible with local and virtual file systems
> 
> The plugin utilizes jsoup, a Java library, that simplifies working with real-world HTML and XML. It offers an easy-to-use API for URL fetching, data parsing, extraction, and manipulation using DOM API methods, CSS, and Xpath selectors.
> 
> The step is located in the Input folder.

<div class="pcm-embed-card" data-href="https://jsoup.org/" data-title="jsoup.org"></div>

20processes%2520by%2520leveraging%2520large%2520language%2520models%2520and%2520other%2520AI%2520technologies.%255Cn%253E%2520%255Cn%253E%2520OpenAI%2520released%2520an%2520API%2520platform%2520that%2520enables%2520the%2520creation%2520of%2520'assistants'%2520that%2520can%2520perform%2520a%2520wide%2520range%2520of%2520tasks%253A%255Cn%253E%2520%255Cn%253E%2520**Natural%2520Language%2520Querying**%253A%2520Users%2520can%2520ask%2520questions%2520or%2520provide%2520prompts%2520to%2520large%2520language%2520models%2520(LLMs)%2520like%2520OpenAI%2520and%2520Azure%2520OpenAI%252C%2520allowing%2520for%2520natural%2520language%2520interaction%2520with%2520data%2520and%2520systems.%255Cn%253E%2520%255Cn%253E%2520**Document%2520Analysis**%253A%2520The%2520plugin%2520supports%2520attaching%2520documents%2520for%2520LLMs%2520to%2520process%252C%2520enabling%2520users%2520to%2520analyze%2520and%2520extract%2520insights%2520from%2520text%2520files%2520and%2520related%2520documents.%255Cn%253E%2520%255Cn%253E%2520**Sentiment%2520Analysis**%253A%2520The%2520plugin%2520can%252C%2520for%2520example%252C%2520be%2520used%2520to%2520determine%2520the%2520sentiment%2520of%2520text%2520data%252C%2520such%2520as%2520tweets.%255Cn%253E%2520%255Cn%253E%2520**Log%2520Analysis**%253A%2520Process%2520and%2520analyze%2520log%2520files%252C%2520potentially%2520for%2520troubleshooting%2520or%2520identifying%2520patterns.%255Cn%253E%2520%255Cn%253E%2520**Structured%2520Data%2520Generation**%253A%2520The%2520plugin%2520supports%2520generating%2520responses%2520in%2520both%2520text%2520and%2520JSON%2520formats%252C%2520allowing%2520for%2520the%2520creation%2520of%2520structured%2520data%2520from%2520natural%2520language%2520inputs.%255Cn%253E%2520%255Cn%253E%2520**Data%2520Extraction%2520and%2520Transformation**%253A%2520The%2520plugin%2520can%2520be%2520used%2520within%2520Pentaho%2520Data%2520Integration%2520(PDI)%2520workflows%252C%2520assisting%2520in%2520extracting%2520and%2520transforming%252
